name: One-Obstruction PC-Minor Basis for Trees
statement: A finite partial cube is a tree if and only if it has no pc-minor isomorphic to $C_4$; the obstruction is pc-minimal.
proof: A tree remains a tree under convex restriction and coordinate contraction. Conversely, a cyclic partial cube contains a convex even cycle, and contracting all but two of its coordinate classes yields $C_4$. Every proper pc-minor of $C_4$ is $K_1$ or $K_2$.
